notes: SLA-focused procurement: negotiating uptime %, credit schedule, maintenance windows, and support SLAs. CTO quote: "Deterministic latency and predictable cost are deal breakers — we can’t accept wide p95 variance." AE notes: pricing delta for 8 GPU reserved vs. pay-as-you-go needs finance approval. Legal has redlined penalty cap and force majeure language.
